measurement.r: GOALS.md Terms r: r = sum(L01 - L00) / sum(T1 - T0) over the target positions of a row set. T0, T1: the unmasked model's log-odds (commute.identity.log_odds: logit minus logsumexp of the other logits, fp32, summed in float64) of the teacher-forced next token under W0 and under the state. L00, L01: masked log-odds with the original subcomponents, delta off (qwen_vpd.masked_logits), under Gamma's gates from W0's clean forward (G0) and from the state's clean forward (G1)
measurement.nan_and_status: r is nan when |sum(T1 - T0)| < 1e-6 (pcfg_vpd.GAIN_MIN). 'scored' when r is finite and the mean gain per target position, sum(T1 - T0) / n, rounded to 9 places, is at least 1.0 (local_faith.MIN_GAIN); otherwise 'unreadable', with gain and numerator still reported
measurement.targets: Every response token of the update's own rows (prompt tokens are not targets), read at the position before it; a row's first token is never a target. Rows: E45's own rows exactly (qwen_reading.own_rows, asserted equal): 64 packed rows of 512 tokens, sequences joined end to end, so a sequence may run across two rows. gold: E40's 256 held-out GSM8K train problems (seed-0 permutation, first 256) with gold solutions, for e40 and gold_s0. facts_s0, facts_s1: the held-template (template 3) fact pairs of seed 0 and 1, for a2long_s0 and a2long_s1. E57 cut these rows to 256 tokens; E144 reads them whole, as E45 did. Targets counted on CPU before filing: gold 14,639 (145 to 312 per row), facts_s0 5,854, facts_s1 5,862
measurement.states: e40 (E40 step 10, regen copy), gold_s0, a2long_s0, a2long_s1 (E45 step 100), each on its own row set. The two random changes of E132 (Gaussian off-span 'gauss', in-span 'inspan'), rebuilt by E132's random_changes and scaled by E132's saved factor (S_gauss.json, S_inspan.json .search.b), each read on all three row sets
measurement.interval: 95% interval of r over 2000 resamples of a row set's 64 rows (qwen_reading.resample, seed = the row set's index: gold 0, facts_s0 1, facts_s1 2; qwen_reading.interval over finite draws). Two states on the same row set share draws (paired); states on different row sets use independent draws
measurement.blind_to: r only sees the trained answer's log-odds at the response positions. It reads high whenever the gates Gamma gives at the changed weights move the masked model the way the weights moved the target, whatever the update did: the $0 check of the plan read 0.88 to 0.94 for every state, random ones included, against the original model's KL. It says nothing about positions or tokens the update did not train
measurement.noise_floor: The row-resample interval of each r, and the seed-pair difference |r(a2long_s0) - r(a2long_s1)| (reported, no rule reads it)

controls_stop_on_miss.norm: Positive control, r = 0: the final RMS norm weight times 2 on the gold rows. Gamma reads the 29 taps (embedding output and each decoder layer's output; the last is layer 27's output before the final norm, qwen_vpd.clean_forward) and each decomposed matrix's input, so this change leaves every input of Gamma unchanged while it changes the logits. G1 must equal G0 bitwise at every site on all 64 rows, and |r| <= 1e-6 with r finite (|gain| >= 1e-6). The brief's layers.27.mlp.down_proj does not qualify: its output is layer 27's output, Gamma's 29th tap

card_rule.pool: the four updates; those 'scored' with finite r enter, each r rounded to 9 places
card_rule.ceiling: every scored update reads r >= 0.85 and max r - min r <= 0.1
card_rule.room: some scored update x reads r < 0.85, and another scored update y reads r_y - r_x > 0.1 (strict) with the 95% interval of r_y - r_x (paired draws on one row set, independent draws across row sets) excluding 0 and finite
card_rule.edge_cases_checked: Run on the code's card_rule, reading and random_rule before filing (scratch script, 2026-11-10, all 17 as written here): empty pool and every update unreadable -> unreadable; one scored -> unreadable; nan r marked scored is left out of the pool (two left at 0.9 and 0.95 -> ceiling); no target positions -> mean gain nan -> unreadable; negative gain -> unreadable (r still shown); all four at 1.0 with nan intervals -> ceiling; two at exactly 0.85 and 0.95 -> ceiling (>= and <= after 9-place rounding, 0.95 - 0.85 = 0.0999... rounds to 0.1); 0.84 against 0.95 with interval [0.05, 0.2] -> room, with [-0.01, 0.2] -> no call, with nan interval -> no call; 0.80 against 0.88 (gap 0.08) -> no call; 0.84 against 0.9400000001 (gap exactly 0.1 after rounding) -> no call; negative r -> room when separated; r above 1 (1.2 and 0.9) -> ceiling fails on spread (0.3), room fails (no r < 0.85) -> no call. The W0 / do-nothing state: gain 0 gives r nan and status unreadable, so four W0 states read 'unreadable' and cannot reach 'ceiling'. A state with r = 0 and a readable gain (as the norm control) reads 'room' against a scored update at 0.9 whose interval excludes 0

random_reference.rule: per random change and row set: 'readable' if the mean gain per target position, rounded to 9 places, is at least 1.0 (MIN_GAIN), else 'unreadable' (nan or negative gain included); gain, numerator and r (when scored) reported beside the updates' (plan reference (i))
